bodyEntries.ts: A swi kotekanga ku hlayisa. Ringeta nakambe.
bodyEntries.ve: A zwo ngo konadzea u vhulunga. Lingedzani hafhu.

bodyEntries.st: Ha ho a kgoneha ho ntjhafatsa setshwantsho sa hao.
bodyEntries.ts: A swi kotekanga ku pfuxeta xifaniso xa wena.
bodyEntries.ve: A zwo ngo konadzea u khwinisa tshifanyiso tshaṋu.

bodyEntries.st: Diphasewete tse ntjha ha di tshwane.

bodyEntries.english: Password must be at least 6 characters.
bodyEntries.st: Phasewete e tlameha ho ba le bonyane ditlhaku tse 6.
bodyEntries.ts: Phasiwedi yi fanele yi va ni swihlawulekisi swa kwalomu ka 6.
bodyEntries.ve: Phasiwede i tea u vha na zwiga zwi si fhasi ha 6.
bodyEntries.zu: Iphasiwedi kumele ibe nezinhlamvu okungenani eziyisi-6.

bodyEntries.st: Akhaonto ya hao e a kenngwa…

bodyEntries.english: You are using the practice version. Nothing here is saved to a real account — sign in to keep your own records.
bodyEntries.st: O sebedisa mofuta wa boikwetliso. Ha ho letho mona le bolokwang akhaontong ya nnete — kena hore o boloke direkoto tsa hao.
bodyEntries.ts: U tirhisa app yo titoloveta. A ku na lexi hlayisiwaka laha eka akhawunti ya xiviri — nghena leswaku u hlayisa tirhekhodo ta wena.
bodyEntries.ve: Ni khou shumisa app ya nḓowenḓowe. A hu na tshithu tshine tsha vhulungwa kha akhaunthu ya vhukuma afha — dzhenani uri ni vhulunge rekhodo dzaṋu.
bodyEntries.zu: Usebenzisa inguqulo yokuzilolonga. Akukho okulondolozwa ku-akhawunti yangempela lapha — ngena ngemvume ukuze ulondoloze amarekhodi akho.

bodyEntries.english: Still loading… you can sign in instead.
bodyEntries.st: E sa ntse e kenngwa… o ka kena ho e na le ho leta.
bodyEntries.ts: Ya ha layicha… u nga nghena ematshan’weni yo rindza.
bodyEntries.ve: I kha ḓi laisiwa… ni nga dzhena vhudzuloni ha u lindela.

bodyEntries.english: Sign in to manage your account.
bodyEntries.st: Kena hore o laole akhaonto ya hao.
bodyEntries.ts: Nghena leswaku u lawula akhawunti ya wena.
bodyEntries.ve: Dzhenani uri ni lange akhaunthu yaṋu.
bodyEntries.zu: Ngena ngemvume ukuze uphathe i-akhawunti yakho.

bodyEntries.ts: Mavito ya wena hi ku helela

bodyEntries.st: (le hlaha hodimo ho di-invoice tsa hao)
bodyEntries.ts: (ri va ehenhla ka ti-invoice ta wena)

bodyEntries.english: Leave this empty to invoice under your own name instead.
bodyEntries.st: Tlohela sena se se na letho hore di-invoice di sebedise lebitso la hao.
bodyEntries.ts: Siya laha ku nga ri na nhlamulo leswaku ti-invoice ti tirhisa vito ra wena.
bodyEntries.ve: Siyani afha hu si na tshithu uri dzi-invoice dzi shumise dzina ḽaṋu.
bodyEntries.zu: Shiya lokhu kungenalutho ukuze i-invoice isebenzise igama lakho.

bodyEntries.english: A photo of your sign works. It is made smaller automatically.
bodyEntries.st: O ka sebedisa setshwantsho sa letshwao la hao. Se fokotswa ka bosona.
bodyEntries.ts: U nga tirhisa xifaniso xa mfungho wa wena. Xi hungutiwa hi xoxe.
bodyEntries.ve: Ni nga shumisa tshifanyiso tsha tshiga tshaṋu. Tshi ṱukufhadzwa nga tshoṱhe.
bodyEntries.zu: Ungafaka isithombe sophawu lwakho. Sizoncishiswa ngokuzenzakalela.

bodyEntries.ve: ImbewuField · i khou aluwa na inwi

bodyEntries.st: Ditumello tsa akhaonto ya hao ha di fetohe.
bodyEntries.ts: Timfanelo ta akhawunti ya wena a ti cinci.
bodyEntries.ve: Thendelo dza akhaunthu yaṋu a dzi shanduki.

bodyEntries.ts: Ku fikelela ka wena eka app

bodyEntries.english: Your account can open every role dashboard. Choose the relevant organisation inside the portfolio.
bodyEntries.st: Akhaonto ya hao e ka bula dashboard ya mosebetsi o mong le o mong. Kgetha mokgatlo o amehang ka hara pokello ya diporojeke.
bodyEntries.ts: Akhawunti ya wena yi nga pfula dashboard ya mintirho hinkwato. Hlawula nhlangano lowu faneleke eka nhlengeleto wa tiphurojeke.
bodyEntries.ve: Akhaunthu yaṋu i nga vula dashboard ya mushumo muṅwe na muṅwe. Nangani dzangano ḽo teaho kha khuvhanganyo ya thandela.
bodyEntries.zu: I-akhawunti yakho ingavula izikrini zazo zonke izindima. Khetha inhlangano efanele ngaphakathi kohlu lwamaphrojekthi.

bodyEntries.english: Your normal login stays the same. A platform administrator must enable owner access on the correct account; choosing a dashboard does not change your permissions.
bodyEntries.st: Mokgwa wa hao wa ho kena ha o fetohe. Motsamaisi wa sethala o tlameha ho dumella phihlello ya monga yona akhaontong e nepahetseng; ho kgetha dashboard ha ho fetole ditumello tsa hao.
bodyEntries.ts: Ndlela ya wena yo nghena a yi cinci. Mulawuri wa pulatifomo u fanele a pfumelela ku fikelela ka n’winyi eka akhawunti leyi faneleke; ku hlawula dashboard a swi cinci timfanelo ta wena.
bodyEntries.ve: Nḓila yaṋu ya u dzhena a i shanduki. Mulanguli wa puḽatifomo u tea u tendela u swikelela ha muṋe kha akhaunthu yo teaho; u nanga dashboard a zwi shanduli thendelo dzaṋu.
bodyEntries.zu: Indlela yakho evamile yokungena ihlala injalo. Umlawuli wohlelo kufanele avule ukufinyelela komnikazi ku-akhawunti efanele; ukukhetha isikrini akuzishintshi izimvume zakho.

bodyEntries.english: Try each role using the Ubhejane farm. Your account role stays the same and practice changes do not affect real projects.
bodyEntries.st: Leka mosebetsi o mong le o mong ka polasi ya Ubhejane. Mosebetsi wa akhaonto ya hao ha o fetohe mme diphetoho tsa boikwetliso ha di ame diporojeke tsa nnete.
bodyEntries.ts: Ringeta mintirho yin’wana ni yin’wana hi purasi ra Ubhejane. Ntirho wa akhawunti ya wena a wu cinci naswona ku cinca ko titoloveta a ku khumbi tiphurojeke ta xiviri.
bodyEntries.ve: Lingedzani mushumo muṅwe na muṅwe nga bulasi ḽa Ubhejane. Mushumo wa akhaunthu yaṋu a u shanduki nahone tshanduko dza nḓowenḓowe a dzi kwami thandela dza vhukuma.
bodyEntries.zu: Zama indima ngayinye usebenzisa ipulazi lase-Ubhejane. Indima ye-akhawunti yakho ihlala injalo, futhi izinguquko zokuzilolonga azithinti amaphrojekthi angempela.

bodyEntries.ve: A zwo ngo konadzea u khwinisa u swikelela. Lingedzani hafhu.

bodyEntries.st: Mokgwa wa ketelo ha o a kgona ho qala.

bodyEntries.zu: I-akhawunti yakho ingena nge-Google — ukushintsha iphasiwedi akusebenzi kuyo.
bodyEntries.st: Akhaonto ya hao e kena ka Google — ho fetola phasewete ha ho sebetse ho yona.
bodyEntries.ts: Akhawunti ya wena yi tirhisa ku nghena ka Google — ku cinca phasiwedi a swi tirhi eka yona.
bodyEntries.ve: Akhaunthu yaṋu i dzhena nga Google — u shandukisa phasiwede a zwi shumi khayo.

bodyEntries.english: Please sign out and sign back in before changing your password.
bodyEntries.zu: Sicela uphume bese ungena futhi ngaphambi kokushintsha iphasiwedi yakho.
bodyEntries.st: Tswa mme o kene hape pele o fetola phasewete ya hao.
bodyEntries.ts: Huma kutani u nghena nakambe u nga si cinca phasiwedi ya wena.
bodyEntries.ve: Bvani ni dovhe ni dzhene musi ni sa athu shandukisa phasiwede yaṋu.

bodyEntries.english: This month's full AI allowance is used. AI still works, on a simpler model, until {date}.
bodyEntries.zu: Isabelo se-AI sale nyanga sesiphelile. I-AI isasebenza, ngohlobo olulula, kuze kube ngu-{date}.
bodyEntries.st: Karolo yohle ya AI ya kgwedi ena e sebedisitswe. AI e ntse e sebetsa, ka mofuta o bobebe, ho fihlela {date}.
bodyEntries.ts: Mpimo wa AI wa n’hweti leyi wu tirhisiwile hinkwawu. AI ya ha tirha, hi modele wo olova, ku fikela {date}.
bodyEntries.ve: Mukovhe woṱhe wa AI wa ṅwedzi uno wo shumiswa. AI i kha ḓi shuma, nga modele yo leluwaho, u swika {date}.

bodyEntries.english: R{remaining} of R{cap} left. Refills on {date}.
bodyEntries.st: Ho setse R{remaining} ho R{cap}. E tlatswa hape ka {date}.
bodyEntries.ts: Ku sale R{remaining} eka R{cap}. Wu tlhela wu tatiwa hi {date}.
bodyEntries.ve: Ho sala R{remaining} kha R{cap}. U dovha wa ḓadzwa nga {date}.

bodyEntries.ts: Pfula tluka ro titoloveta: Museketeri wa mali

bodyEntries.english: Your crop sales and the money you earned from them.
bodyEntries.st: Dijalo tseo o di rekisitseng le tjhelete eo o e fumaneng ka tsona.
bodyEntries.ts: Dibyariwa leswi u swi xaviseke ni mali leyi u yi kumeke hi swona.
bodyEntries.ve: Zwibveledzwa zwaṋu zwa masimuni zwe na rengisa na tshelede ye na wana ngazwo.

bodyEntries.english: What you paid for seed, tools and inputs.
bodyEntries.zu: Imali oyikhokhele imbewu, amathuluzi nezinsiza zokulima.
bodyEntries.st: Seo o se lefileng bakeng sa peo, disebediswa le dintho tsa temo.
bodyEntries.ts: Leswi u swi hakeleke eka mbewu, switirho ni switirhisiwa swa vurimi.
bodyEntries.ve: Zwe na badela kha mbeu, zwishumiswa na zwishumiswa zwa vhulimi.

bodyEntries.st: Boima ba kotulo ya hao bakeng sa sejalo ka seng.
bodyEntries.ts: Ntiko wa ntshovelo wa wena eka xibyariwa xin’wana ni xin’wana.
bodyEntries.ve: Zwileme zwa khaṋo yaṋu kha tshimela tshiṅwe na tshiṅwe.

bodyEntries.english: Which course modules you have finished.
bodyEntries.st: Dikarolo tsa thupelo tseo o di qetileng.
bodyEntries.ts: Swiyenge swa khoso leswi u swi heteke.
bodyEntries.ve: Zwipiḓa zwa khoso zwe na fhedza.

bodyEntries.english: The answers you gave in programme surveys.
bodyEntries.st: Dikarabo tseo o faneng ka tsona dipatlisisong tsa lenaneo.
bodyEntries.ts: Tinhlamulo leti u ti nyikeke eka mindzavisiso ya nongonoko.
bodyEntries.ve: Phindulo dze na ṋea kha ṱhoḓisiso dza mbekanyamushumo.

bodyEntries.st: Moo polasi ya hao e leng teng
bodyEntries.ts: Laha purasi ra wena ri nga kona
bodyEntries.ve: Hune bulasi ḽaṋu ḽa vha hone

bodyEntries.english: Your exact plot location. With this off, only the district is shown.
bodyEntries.zu: Indawo eqondile yensimu yakho. Uma lokhu kuvaliwe, kuboniswa isifunda kuphela.
bodyEntries.st: Sebaka se nepahetseng sa tshimo ya hao. Ha sena se timilwe, ho bontshwa setereke feela.
bodyEntries.ts: Ndhawu leyi kongomeke ya nsimu ya wena. Loko leswi swi timiwile, ku kombisiwa xifundzha ntsena.
bodyEntries.ve: Fhethu ho livhaho ha tshipiḓa tsha mavu aṋu. Musi izwi zwo dzimiwa, hu sumbedzwa tshiṱiriki fhedzi.

bodyEntries.english: Nothing here is shared unless you switch it on. You can change your mind at any time, and {organisation} will stop seeing it straight away.
bodyEntries.zu: Akukho lutho olwabiwayo lapha ngaphandle kokuthi uyivule. Ungashintsha umqondo wakho noma nini, futhi {organisation} izoyeka ukukubona ngokushesha.
bodyEntries.st: Ha ho letho mona le arolelanwang ntle le ha o le bulela. O ka fetola maikutlo a hao neng kapa neng, mme {organisation} o tla kgaotsa ho le bona hanghang.
bodyEntries.ts: A ku na lexi avelaniwaka laha handle ka loko u xi pfula. U nga cinca miehleketo ya wena nkarhi wun’wana ni wun’wana, kutani {organisation} wu ta tshika ku xi vona hi nkarhi wolowo.
bodyEntries.ve: A hu na tshithu tshine tsha kovhiwa afha nga nnḓa ha musi no tshi vula. Ni nga shandukisa muhumbulo waṋu tshifhinga tshiṅwe na tshiṅwe, nahone {organisation} ḽi ḓo litsha u tshi vhona nga u ṱavhanya.

bodyEntries.st: mokgatlo o tsamaisang lenaneo la hao
bodyEntries.ts: nhlangano lowu fambisaka nongonoko wa wena
bodyEntries.ve: dzangano ḽine ḽa tshimbidza mbekanyamushumo yaṋu

bodyEntries.english: Couldn't load your sharing settings. Check your connection and try again.
bodyEntries.zu: Izilungiselelo zokwabelana azikwazi ukulayishwa. Hlola uxhumano lwakho bese uzama futhi.
bodyEntries.st: Ha ho a kgoneha ho kenya ditlhophiso tsa hao tsa ho arolelana. Hlahloba kgokahano ya hao mme o leke hape.
bodyEntries.ts: A swi kotekanga ku layicha swiyimiso swa wena swo avelana. Kambela vuhlanganisi bya wena kutani u ringeta nakambe.
bodyEntries.ve: A zwo ngo konadzea u laisa nzudzanyo dzaṋu dza u kovhana. Ṱolani vhuṱumani haṋu ni lingedze hafhu.

bodyEntries.english: That did not save. Your sharing settings have not changed.
bodyEntries.zu: Lokho akugcinwanga. Izilungiselelo zakho zokwabelana azishintshanga.
bodyEntries.st: Seo ha se a bolokwa. Ditlhophiso tsa hao tsa ho arolelana ha di a fetoha.
bodyEntries.ts: Sweswo a swi hlayisiwanga. Swiyimiso swa wena swo avelana a swi cincanga.
bodyEntries.ve: Izwo a zwo ngo vhulungwa. Nzudzanyo dzaṋu dza u kovhana a dzo ngo shanduka.
